overall_assessment: All 28 courses were reviewed in full, including 20 suspects and eight random controls. No personal-data leaks or substantive course-content losses were found: the five removed flags reflect correct semester removal from short plans, and all name_like flags concern departments, organisations, programmes or course titles. Administrative dates remain in ten courses through three distinct rule gaps; incomplete literature phrases also occur in three courses, including one random control, while the other controls show appropriate removal without substantive damage.

findings.evidence: LKI106 Profesjonsfag- Elevers læring og utvikling, læreplanteori og utdanningshistorie (Vår 2024)
findings.description: Four course headings retain their offering semester and year: both LKI106 offerings and both KRØ101 offerings. These admin_date flags are real: a semester attached to the course title is administrative dating, even when the subject concerns curricula; it is not the date of a government document.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R: .gov_doc_regex matches læreplan within Læreplanarbeid and læreplanteori; .not_gov then suppresses semester removal when that substring occurs within 80 characters before the semester in the course heading.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip terminal parenthesised offering semesters from identifiable course-title lines before applying the government-document date guard. Keep that guard for dates attached to government documents in course content, and avoid treating curriculum-related subject words alone as sufficient evidence of a dated document.

findings.description: All three sampled autumn PhD courses retain dated registration deadlines (13, 20 and 6 September 2025). These admin_date flags identify administrative dates that must be removed, rather than learning content or government-document dates.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R defines .long_dates_regex but .anon_generic() applies it to approval/update contexts and timestamps, not Påmeldingsfrist lines. NIH has no institution-specific handler to remove these registration dates.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a line-scoped rule for Påmeldingsfrist followed by .long_dates_regex, removing the deadline value and terminal punctuation while preserving subsequent lines. Scope the rule to the administrative label so publication and government-document dates remain intact.

findings.description: All three sampled English friluftsliv courses retain fall/Fall 2024 in their literature-list notices. These are semester-year labels, not publication dates of literature references. They occur in name_like suspects but are not flagged as admin_date, showing a blind spot in the pre-pass.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R: .season_regex recognises autumn but omits its English synonym fall; the other season/year patterns also omit fall.
findings.suggested_fix: Recognise case-insensitive fall alongside autumn in the season-year removal patterns, with a word boundary and adjacent year. Remove any resulting empty literature-list notice as a complete line, preserving actual references.

findings.description: Semester removal leaves incomplete literature phrases: Kjernelitteratur for. in two suspects and Anbefalt litteratur for. in a random control. These are half-removed phrases with a dangling preposition, rather than the harmless bare administrative labels allowed by the rubric. No substantive reading-list entries are shown as removed.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R: .anon_generic() removes the season-year value, but its cleanup for newly bare literature notices only matches lines starting Pensumlist followed by for. It misses Kjernelitteratur for and Anbefalt litteratur for.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the anchored post-semester cleanup to complete lines consisting only of Kjernelitteratur for or Anbefalt litteratur for, optional punctuation and whitespace. Preserve the section heading and all lines containing reference content.
